summary: Watching his earlier interviews that day just horrifies me. Seems so determined and knowing the good he was doing.... How did we get here? When young kids feel their duty to join militias and possibly shoot down other Americans?
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Watching his earlier interviews that day just horrifies me. Seems so determined and knowing the good he was doing.... How did we get here?

When young kids feel their duty to join militias and possibly shoot down other Americans?
